## Highlights since 0.19.1

- **Resize Markdown table columns.** In the native Lattice, drag a column border in a Markdown file's visual editor to resize that column, or double-click the border to fit the column to its content. Lattice remembers the widths for each table and opens the file with them next time, including after a rename or move. The `.md` file itself doesn't change, so Overleaf, git and other editors see plain Markdown.
- **Pick the Agent's font size.** In the native Lattice, Settings › Agent › Display sets the Agent's font size, from 11 to 20 px, apart from the editors' sizes. The conversation, the message box and code blocks all scale with it, in the panel and in the Agent's own window.
- **Overleaf keeps your live typing when you switch projects.** When you switch a window to another project while an Overleaf file is open, Lattice now sends your last typing and hands the file back to Overleaf before it leaves, in both versions of Lattice. When you come back, a co-author's edits made in the meantime merge cleanly with yours instead of showing up as conflict markers.

## Notable fixes

- Live preview starts rtex again by itself when it exits mid-session, for example when macOS ends it under memory pressure, in both versions of Lattice. Only when rtex stops three times within five minutes does live preview stop, and its pill then says how often and how rtex ended. A document whose first pass has a TeX error now shows "Waiting for the document to compile" instead of "Live preview stopped".
- In spreadsheets, Control-click now opens the context menu as a right-click does, and ⌘-click adds another range to the selection. A right-click no longer tints the whole sheet, and a cell whose value held a control character no longer shows a box or opens an empty editor.
- In the native Lattice, the arrow keys, Home and End no longer type box characters into the visual Markdown editor, a spreadsheet or the Agent's message box.
- In the native Lattice, the pointer over the visual Markdown editor, a spreadsheet and the Agent's message box shows the page's own cursor, such as the I-beam over text or the resize cursor on a table's column border, instead of an arrow.
- In the native Lattice, ⌘Z and ⌘⇧Z undo and redo in a Markdown file's visual editor, a whole typed word at a time.
- In a Markdown file's visual editor, a click on an inline formula selects that formula and opens its settings, instead of highlighting the paragraph from its start.
- In the file tree, a click on empty space clears the selection, so the + button creates a file or folder at the top of the project. The name field for a new or renamed file no longer overlaps its icon.
- On Linux, a tool such as `du` walking the runtime folder no longer stops the Agent. When the Agent's background process exits on its own, Lattice now starts a new one instead of finding it gone at the next request.
- Report a Problem, Download, About and the user guide now open Lattice's new home at lattice-writer.
